document_types.description: High-level, mandatory enterprise rule established by executive leadership or governance bodies to define required behaviors, boundaries, and organizational commitments.
document_types.intended_use: Sets enterprise compliance expectations, legal baselines, security mandates, and high-level corporate guardrails.

document_types.description: Mandatory technical, architectural, or procedural specification specifying exact requirements, configurations, protocols, and criteria that must be satisfied.
document_types.intended_use: Ensures consistency, interoperability, and security across software engineering, AI model deployments, and infrastructure systems.

document_types.description: Recommended best practices, advisory patterns, and operational suggestions that guide decision-making without being strictly mandatory.
document_types.intended_use: Aids engineers, managers, and teams in selecting optimal approaches, tools, and workflows within approved corporate standards.

document_types.description: Step-by-step sequential instructions established to perform a routine business, security, or administrative process with repeatable outcomes.
document_types.intended_use: Guides employees through structured operational sequences such as onboarding, expense reporting, or access request approvals.

document_types.description: Detailed, highly technical procedural guide designed for engineers and operators to execute specific maintenance, infrastructure operations, or incident remediation steps.
document_types.intended_use: Enables rapid, error-free execution during system maintenance, failover events, service restarts, and site reliability tasks.

document_types.description: Comprehensive reference document compiling policies, organizational norms, benefits, cultural values, and working practices for a broad audience.
document_types.intended_use: Serves as the central orientation and general reference guide for employees, managers, and cross-functional teams.

document_types.description: Broad conceptual and architectural structure providing principles, lifecycle models, maturity levels, and governance criteria for a complex domain.
document_types.intended_use: Structures major enterprise disciplines such as AI Governance, Enterprise Risk Management, and Zero-Trust Security.

document_types.description: Strategic, scenario-based operational response guide detailing pre-planned workflows, communication trees, and escalation pathways for specific events.
document_types.intended_use: Coordinates rapid cross-functional response during cybersecurity breaches, major service outages, PR crises, or regulatory audits.
